articles.titleCn: 从单一聊天机器人到受监管的智能体生态系统：面向关键任务医院信息管理系统的智能体式人工智能模式目录与编排框架
articles.abstractCn: 医院正竞相将人工智能嵌入到分诊管理、文档记录、日程安排和收入周期工作流程中，同时应对其他行业技术应用的激增，然而大多数部署仍停留在边缘的试点阶段，使患者和机构面临运营脆弱性、不受监管的风险以及不断累积的技术债务。与此同时，根据Fortune Business Insights的报告，全球医疗保健人工智能市场预计到2034年将超过近万亿美元，这加剧了架构失误和扩展策略失败带来的财务后果。本研究提出了一种以合规为先的智能体人工智能模式目录和编排框架，专门为医疗信息系统构建，超越单一的LLM聊天机器人，迈向一个受监管的自主和半自主智能体生态系统。该框架通过增加（i）智能体角色的分类法，（ii）一个正式的风险分层模型，将每个模式映射到风险等级、人工参与检查点和治理挂钩，以及（iii）一个统一的编排运行时环境，能够协调跨Epic、Cerner和MEDITECH等电子健康记录/医疗信息系统环境的多个智能体工作流程。技术层面，该框架结合了基于vLLM的推理、优化的分页内存、机密计算以及基于本地部署的MCP，强制执行端到端加密和与HIPAA、GDPR、欧盟人工智能法案、印度的DPDP和DISHA法案、ISO 27001、ISO 27002、ISO 14971和IEC 62304相一致的策略即代码控制。我们展示了所提出的架构如何能够有效减少文档时间、集成工作量和人工智能试点流失率，同时加强治理和可审计性，为医院领导层和监管机构提供了一份迫切需要的蓝图，将人工智能投资转化为可持续的临床、运营和财务投资回报率。

articles.title: DocMemo: Dynamic Evidence Discovery via Probabilistic Memory-Guided Retrieval for Multi-Modal Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Long-document understanding requires locating sparse and heterogeneous evidence across hundreds of pages, yet existing systems remain limited by static retrieval and fragile cross-round memory. Mainstream single-round methods commit to a fixed top-$k$ page set at the outset and struggle to recover from early retrieval errors; recent iterative approaches allow multi-round evidence acquisition, but they do not investigate the propagation mechanism of cross-round states, making it difficult to track the dynamic changes in page relevance. To address these limitations, we propose DocMemo, a memory-guided framework that formulates long-document reasoning as dynamic evidence exploration. DocMemo maintains a tri-level retrieval state consisting of Document Schema Memory, Page Belief Memory, and Question Episodic Memory, which respectively capture structural priors, dynamic relevance estimation, and query-specific reasoning trajectories. During reasoning, DocMemo continuously refines cross-round page selection through Bayesian page belief updating with Thompson sampling, spatial proximity propagation, and structure-aware adaptive-granularity evidence access, while supplementing page-level evidence with fine-grained visual regions. Experiments on 3 benchmarks show that DocMemo achieves state-of-the-art performance and validate the efficacy of structured memory and dynamic page belief updating. Code is available at https://github.com/Harrygof/DocMemo.
articles.comment: DocMemo is a memory-guided framework for long-document reasoning that uses tri-level memory and dynamic Bayesian belief updating to overcome static retrieval limits and improve evidence tracking. 16 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables
articles.titleCn: 文档备忘录：基于概率记忆引导检索的多模态文档理解的动态证据发现
articles.abstractCn: 长文档理解需要定位分散且异构的证据，跨越数百页，但现有系统仍受限于静态检索和脆弱的跨轮记忆。主流单轮方法在开始时承诺固定的top-k页面集，难以从早期的检索错误中恢复；最近的迭代方法允许多轮证据获取，但它们没有研究跨轮状态的传播机制，导致难以追踪页面相关性的动态变化。为解决这些限制，我们提出了DocMemo，一个以记忆引导的框架，将长文档推理形式化为动态证据探索。DocMemo维护一个三级检索状态，包括文档结构记忆、页面信念记忆和问题情景记忆，分别捕获结构先验、动态相关性估计和特定查询的推理轨迹。在推理过程中，DocMemo通过贝叶斯页面信念更新、Thompson采样、空间邻近传播和结构感知自适应粒度证据访问，持续优化跨轮页面选择，同时用细粒度的视觉区域补充页面级证据。在3个基准测试上的实验表明，DocMemo实现了最先进的性能，并验证了结构化记忆和动态页面信念更新的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/Harrygof/DocMemo获取。

articles.title: An Agentic Hybrid Top-Down and Bottom-Up Approach to Knowledge Graph Generation
articles.abstract: Organizing thousands of unstandardized, multilingual expertise declarations is a persistent challenge for Human Resources (HR) platforms, directly impacting downstream tasks like accurate talent matching. To address this, we propose a hybrid knowledge graph generation pipeline that grounds a Large Language Model (LLM) in the Wikidata multilingual Knowledge Graph (KG) while employing an agentic reflexion pattern to synthesize emerging concepts and their associated metadata. Unlike rigid top-down methods or fragmented bottom-up approaches, our system anchors recognized concepts to stable Knowledge Graph entities while dynamically creating new nodes and relational metadata for unrecognized skills. Executed across five stages, entity reconciliation, multilingual canonicalization, active curation, deduplication, and the iterative recovery of unmapped concepts, the system autonomously adapts to rapidly evolving, noisy skill mentions across five European languages. Ultimately, this pipeline provides a highly scalable, explicable, and self-healing framework for generating a comprehensive skills knowledge graph, from which a structured taxonomy is derived, using unstructured, noisy text.
articles.titleCn: 一种基于代理的混合自上而下和自下而上的知识图谱生成方法
articles.abstractCn: 将成千上万种非标准化、多语种的专长声明进行组织，一直是人力资源（HR）平台面临的持续挑战，直接影响下游任务如精准人才匹配。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种混合知识图谱生成流程，将大型语言模型（LLM）锚定在Wikidata多语种知识图谱（KG）上，同时采用代理式反思模式来综合新兴概念及其相关元数据。与僵化的自上而下方法或碎片化的自下而上方法不同，我们的系统将已识别的概念锚定到稳定的知识图谱实体上，同时为未识别的技能动态创建新节点和关系元数据。该系统分五个阶段执行：实体对齐、多语种规范化、主动管理、去重以及未映射概念的迭代恢复，能够自主适应五种欧洲语言中快速变化、嘈杂的技能提及。最终，该流程提供了一个高度可扩展、可解释且自愈的框架，用于从非结构化、嘈杂的文本中生成全面的技能知识图谱，并从中推导出结构化分类体系。

articles.title: Does More Retrieved Evidence Help Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Diffusion Language Models?
articles.abstract: Visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) commonly expands the retrieved evidence set to improve answer-page coverage, implicitly assuming that all available evidence should be passed to the generator. We show that this assumption does not hold for diffusion language models (DLMs): retrieving more pages increases answer-page recall, whereas unconditionally passing all retrieved pages to the generator often reduces answer accuracy, primarily because of semantic conflict. A latent-source analysis explains this mismatch through source-coherence loss in parallel denoising, where position-wise proposals can combine incompatible visual sources into unsupported answers. We further find that such interference is already visible in the first-step answer-block distribution, making it possible to assess evidence before decoding. To preserve retrieval coverage while limiting harmful visual exposure, we propose the Entropy-Based Candidate Filter (ECF), a training-free evidence-admission framework. To reduce irrelevant content within individual candidates, ECF constructs multi-granularity evidence units; to identify beneficial additional evidence, it uses blank-controlled block confidence and retrieval rank to determine whether and which candidate should enter the final context. Across three multimodal DLMs and five visual QA benchmarks, ECF improves answer accuracy by 2.62 percentage points on average over the strongest fixed top-$k$ input and, with LLaDA2.0-Uni, by 2.37 percentage points on average over the best competing training-free result for each dataset. These results show that broader retrieval benefits visual DLM-RAG through selective evidence admission rather than unconditional evidence expansion. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/wjkuser/ECF.
articles.titleCn: 检索到的更多证据是否有助于基于扩散语言模型的视觉检索增强生成？
articles.abstractCn: 视觉检索增强生成（RAG）通常通过扩展检索证据集来提高答案页覆盖率，隐含地假设所有可用证据都应传递给生成器。我们证明这一假设对于扩散语言模型（DLMs）并不成立：检索更多页面会增加答案页召回率，而无条件地将所有检索到的页面传递给生成器通常会降低答案准确性，这主要是由于语义冲突。潜在源分析通过并行去噪中的源一致性损失解释了这种不匹配，其中位置式提议可以将不兼容的视觉源组合成不受支持的答案。我们进一步发现这种干扰在第一步答案块分布中就已经可见，这使得在解码前评估证据成为可能。为了在限制有害视觉暴露的同时保留检索覆盖率，我们提出了基于熵的候选过滤（ECF），这是一个无需训练的证据准入框架。为了减少单个候选中的无关内容，ECF构建了多粒度证据单元；为了识别有益的额外证据，它使用空白控制的块置信度和检索排名来确定是否以及哪个候选应进入最终上下文。在三个多模态DLMs和五个视觉问答基准上，ECF平均比最强的固定top-k输入提高了2.62个百分点，在与每个数据集的最佳无训练结果相比时，使用LLaDA2.0-Uni平均提高了2.37个百分点。这些结果表明，更广泛的检索通过选择性证据准入而非无条件证据扩展使视觉DLM-RAG受益。代码公开可在https://github.com/wjkuser/ECF。

articles.title: GPTKB 2.0: Browsing, Querying, and Auditing a Disambiguated LLM-Derived Knowledge Base
articles.abstract: We present a web demo for exploring a large-scale disambiguated knowledge base (KB) materialized from a large language model (LLM). GPTKB 2.0 contains 38.4M triples over 1.6M canonical entities, together with 207.6K consolidated relations and 66K consolidated classes. Unlike prior LLM-derived knowledge bases that largely identify entities by surface strings, GPTKB 2.0 performs context-guided disambiguation during recursive KB construction, separating homonyms and merging synonymous mentions as facts are elicited. The demo makes this process inspectable: users can browse entities, follow links across the KB, and audit the provenance of individual facts, including surface forms, candidate matches, source triples, and disambiguation decisions. The interface further supports structured SPARQL queries, natural-language questions translated to SPARQL, and entity linking from user-provided text to canonical GPTKB 2.0 entries. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/, with the full KB downloadable for offline use.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 11 figures
articles.titleCn: GPTKB 2.0：浏览、查询和审计一个消歧的LLM衍生知识库
articles.abstractCn: 我们展示了一个用于探索由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的、大规模消歧知识库（KB）的网页演示。GPTKB 2.0 包含 3840 万个三元组、160 万个规范实体、207.6 万个整合关系和 6.6 万个整合类。与以往主要通过表面字符串识别实体的 LLM 生成的知识库不同，GPTKB 2.0 在递归知识库构建过程中进行上下文引导的消歧，分离同音异义词并将同义提及作为事实提取时进行合并。该演示使这一过程可视化：用户可以浏览实体、跨知识库进行链接跟踪，并审核单个事实的来源，包括表面形式、候选匹配、来源三元组和消歧决策。界面进一步支持结构化 SPARQL 查询、自然语言问题转换为 SPARQL，以及从用户提供的文本到规范 GPTKB 2.0 条目的实体链接。GPTKB 2.0 可在 https://gptkb.org/ 访问，完整知识库可下载用于离线使用。

articles.title: Confirming Our Biases? Evaluating the Capabilities, Risks, and Societal Impact of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: It is well established that large language models (LLMs) are sensitive to prompt framing, reflecting patterns in their training data or prior prompts. In this study, we investigate the extent to which LLMs reinforce users biases expressed in the prompts and examine the boundary between implicit framing effects and explicit prompt manipulation. Specifically, we evaluate how susceptible LLMs are to direct and suggestive prompts that encourage models to support or challenge particular positions. We evaluate six LLMs using 160 distinct prompts spanning ten topics across opinion-based and factual domains. The prompts systematically vary in prompting strategy, support versus challenge instructions, prompt polarity, users' expressed beliefs, and topic domain, spanning both opinion-based and factual questions. Our results show that LLMs systematically adapt their responses to align with prompt framing, even in factual contexts. This suggests that prompt framing can outweigh factual consistency in model responses. Overall, our findings delineate the extent and boundaries of LLM manipulability. Furthermore, the results imply that LLMs can reinforce subtle user biases and are susceptible to explicit prompt manipulation even in domains where responses should remain factually stable.
articles.titleCn: 确认我们的偏见？评估大型语言模型的能力、风险和社会影响
articles.abstractCn: 众所周知，大型语言模型（LLMs）对提示框架敏感，这反映了它们训练数据或先前提示中的模式。在本研究中，我们探究了LLMs在多大程度上会强化提示中表达的用户偏见，并考察了隐性框架效应与显性提示操纵之间的界限。具体而言，我们评估了LLMs对鼓励模型支持或挑战特定立场的直接和暗示性提示的易感性。我们使用160个涵盖十个主题（基于观点和事实领域）的不同提示，评估了六个LLMs。这些提示在提示策略、支持与挑战指令、提示极性、用户表达的信念以及主题领域上系统变化，涵盖了基于观点和事实的问题。我们的结果表明，LLMs会系统地调整其响应以符合提示框架，即使在事实性语境中也是如此。这表明提示框架可以超越事实一致性，在模型响应中占据主导地位。总体而言，我们的研究界定了LLM可被操纵的程度和范围。此外，结果表明，LLMs能够强化微妙的用户偏见，并且在应该保持事实稳定的领域，它们对显性提示操纵也表现出易感性。

articles.title: PHASE-Tree: Modeling Character-State Evolution in Long-Horizon Role-Playing Dialogue
articles.abstract: Long-horizon role-playing demands that characters remain recognizable as they evolve with the narrative. Yet existing work falls short on two fronts: representations are typically static profiles that cannot be updated locally without destabilizing unchanged traits, and benchmarks mainly test persona preservation and memory recall rather than whether a model speaks from a character's currently evolved state. We address both. PHASE-Tree is a multi-timescale character-state tree with an immutable identity root and mutable persona, session, and moment layers, making each mutable field an addressable target for localized within- and cross-episode updates. It conditions generation through explicit textual provision or implicit parametric adaptation. To measure evolved-state generation, we introduce LongEvoRoleBench, which pairs four long-dialogue corpora for cross-episode evolution with four short-dialogue corpora as within-scene state-tracking checks, under a unified next-utterance protocol. On the long-dialogue core, textual PHASE-Tree ranks first in 11 of 12 dataset-metric cells against internal variants and all 12 cells against external textual baselines, improving character-level, semantic, and embedding scores by 19.7%, 12.4%, and 15.1% respectively. In a blinded 200-response study, human ratings correlate with the GPT-4.1 judge (Pearson r= 0.65); on descriptive n= 10 PT and NR prompt subsets, the Overall difference is +0.20. The long-dialogue Sem advantage persists across LLM judges and generation backbones.
articles.titleCn: PHASE-Tree：长时程角色扮演对话中字符状态演化的建模
articles.abstractCn: 长时程角色扮演要求角色在叙事发展中保持可识别性。然而现有工作存在两大不足：一是角色表征通常是静态的配置文件，无法在不破坏未变更特征的情况下进行本地更新；二是基准测试主要关注角色保留和记忆召回，而非模型是否从角色的当前发展状态进行对话。我们同时解决了这两个问题。PHASE-Tree是一种多时间尺度角色状态树，具有不可变身份根和可变角色、会话及时刻层，使每个可变字段成为本地跨集更新和场景内更新的可寻址目标。它通过显式文本提供或隐式参数适配来条件化生成。为衡量发展状态生成，我们引入了LongEvoRoleBench，该基准将四个长对话语料库配对用于跨集演化，同时将四个短对话语料库作为场景内状态追踪检查，在统一的下一句协议下进行。在长对话核心数据集上，文本PHASE-Tree在12个数据集指标单元中的11个单元优于内部变体，在所有12个单元优于外部文本基线，分别将角色级、语义和嵌入分数提高了19.7%、12.4%和15.1%。在盲法200次响应研究中，人类评分与GPT-4.1裁判的相关性（Pearson r=0.65）；在描述性n=10 PT和NR提示子集上，总体差异为+0.20。长对话语义优势在LLM裁判和生成骨干中持续存在。

articles.title: Can Language Models Imagine Without Seeing? Ekphrasis: Measuring Visual Creative Ideation in Text-Only LLMs
articles.abstract: Current evaluations do not isolate whether text-only language models can originate visual concepts before image generation. Fluent visual prose can hide visual-plan failures: an answer may appear creative while repeating familiar visual clichés or failing to specify a renderable scene. We define Visual Creative Ideation (VCI) as the ability to produce textual visual plans that are useful, expressive, and population-novel, and introduce Ekphrasis, a 400-task benchmark spanning Abstraction, Combination, Transformation, and Adaptation. Ekphrasis scores anonymized pairwise comparisons with dimension-specific checklists, aggregates preferences with Bradley-Terry models, and uses Typed Idea Graphs to convert task-specific population clichés into novelty references. Across 14 language models, VCI separates usefulness, expressiveness, and novelty rather than reducing to fluency: strong models achieve similar overall scores through different profiles, and useful plans can remain visually clichéd. A cross-modal grounding study further shows that text-level VCI ordering largely survives faithful rendering and blind image-level preference judgment, supporting Ekphrasis as a measure of visual ideation beyond prose quality.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 4 main figures, with appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/Imhongyu/Ekphrasis
articles.titleCn: 语言模型能否在看不见的情况下想象？具象化表达：仅文本形式的大型语言模型中视觉创造性构思的测量
articles.abstractCn: 当前的评估无法区分纯文本语言模型是否能在图像生成之前产生视觉概念。流畅的视觉描述可以掩盖视觉方案上的缺陷：答案可能看似有创意，但实际上是在重复熟悉的视觉陈词滥调，或者未能具体描述可渲染的场景。我们将视觉创意构思（VCI）定义为产生有用、表达丰富且群体新颖的文本视觉方案的能力，并引入Ekphrasis，这是一个涵盖抽象、组合、转换和适应的400任务基准。Ekphrasis通过维度特定的检查清单对匿名成对比较进行评分，使用Bradley-Terry模型聚合偏好，并利用类型化概念图将特定任务的群体陈词滥调转化为新颖参考。在14种语言模型中，VCI区分了有用性、表达力和新颖性，而非简化为流畅性：强模型通过不同的特征组合实现了相似的总体评分，而有用方案仍可能保持视觉上的陈词滥调。一项跨模态基础研究进一步表明，文本级别的VCI排序在很大程度上在忠实渲染和盲目的图像级别偏好判断中得以保留，这支持了Ekphrasis作为衡量视觉构思能力的指标，而不仅仅是文本质量。

articles.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
articles.abstract: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing the stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside raises retention by about 15 points on two models (37 claims to 2 on one, 30 to 8 on the other; permutation p=0.00005), and a pre-registered replication on Haiku, its prediction and decision rule committed before the run, gives +15.6 points, 38 claims to 1. Ablating the format on both models gives the same net effect from different parts: labels help on both (+9.7 and +12.8) and length helps on neither, but wording the stance as a full sentence is the largest component on one model (+12.5) and worth nothing on the other (+0.6). Either model alone would have licensed a confident and different mechanism, so we claim only the intersection: make the stance explicit, not merely longer, and expect the best way of being explicit to depend on the model. A deterministic readout with no model reproduces the two-cell direction and five of seven ablation contrasts, but not length or labels, which we therefore do not claim on one instrument. Fifty hand labels (kappa=0.75) agree on direction; we print their seven disagreements in full. We also report nine withdrawn claims, three of them former title claims of this paper.

articles.titleCn: 明确，不再：是什么让认知立场在记忆压缩中得以幸存
articles.abstractCn: 代理记忆系统会压缩它们存储的内容，而压缩过程会删除限定词，因此一个主张的认知地位往往无法在写入记忆后得以保留。我们探究了是什么因素决定了它能否得以保留。匹配笔记包含相同的主张和立场，唯一不同的是立场所在的位置；一个模型在相同的预算内，对相同的填充笔记压缩两者，并且一个从未见过条件的盲读者对结果进行评分。在七个语域中的60个主张中，将立场作为标记字段而不是括号旁注写入，两个模型的保留率提高了约15分（一个模型从37个主张提高到2个，另一个从30个提高到8个；置换p=0.00005），并且一个预先注册的Haiku复制实验，其预测和决策规则在运行前就已确定，提高了+15.6分，从38个主张提高到1个。在两个模型上移除格式会产生相同净效果的不同部分：标签在两个模型上都有帮助（+9.7和+12.8），而长度在两个模型上都没有帮助，但将立场表述为完整句子是其中一个模型的最大组成部分（+12.5），而在另一个模型上则毫无价值（+0.6）。任何一个模型单独都足以支持一种自信且不同的机制，因此我们仅提出交集：使立场明确，而不仅仅是更长，并预期最明确的方式取决于模型。一个没有模型的确定性读出重现了双细胞方向和七个移除对比中的五个，但未重现长度或标签，因此我们不在一个仪器上声称这些。五十个手动标签（kappa=0.75）在方向上达成一致；我们完整打印了它们的七个分歧。我们还报告了九个撤回的主张，其中三个是本文前期的标题主张。

articles.title: Ask-E: An Environment for Calibrated Question Generation
articles.abstract: Today, we improve models by training and evaluating them on problems at the frontier of their abilities. Creating such problems is itself a demanding task, requiring the ability to probe model limits and generalize beyond existing question distributions. It also means placing problems at a precise difficulty level, which requires understanding what it takes to solve them. In short, generating problems calibrated to a model's current frontier demands capability beyond it, an increasingly burdensome constraint as models improve. Our key insight is that we can leverage this constraint to our advantage: a model that can generate problems consistently calibrated to a given frontier must possess capability beyond it. Accordingly, we present Ask-E, an environment that benchmarks and trains models on their ability to write questions at a given skill level, rather than answer them. Concretely, we define target skill levels as ranges bounded by the capabilities of two existing language models. A generated question is successfully calibrated if exactly one of the two models can solve it, placing it precisely within the target range and differentiating the capabilities of these models. Ask-E serves both as a benchmark and a training environment, where models generate problems calibrated to a variety of skill levels. We find that even frontier models achieve below 50% calibration on the benchmark, leaving significant headroom to measure future progress. We also show that training on this environment leads to improvements across a number of downstream math benchmarks even with no new math data, no interaction with stronger models, and no correctness-based reward.
articles.titleCn: Ask-E：一个校准问题生成的环境
articles.abstractCn: 如今，我们通过在模型能力前沿的问题上进行训练和评估来改进模型。创建这类问题本身就是一项艰巨的任务，需要具备探测模型极限和超越现有问题分布泛化的能力。这也意味着将问题置于精确的难度水平上，这需要理解解决这些问题所需的条件。简而言之，生成针对模型当前前沿校准的问题需要超越模型自身的能力，而随着模型的改进，这种约束变得越来越沉重。我们的关键洞察在于，我们可以利用这种约束来为我们所用：一个能够持续生成针对给定前沿校准问题的模型，必须具备超越其自身的能力。因此，我们提出了Ask-E环境，该环境用于评估和训练模型在特定技能水平上编写问题的能力，而不是回答问题。具体而言，我们将目标技能水平定义为由两个现有语言模型能力界限所界定的范围。如果生成的题目恰好只有一个模型能够解决，则认为其成功校准，这将其精确地置于目标范围内，并区分了这些模型的能力。Ask-E既是一个基准测试环境，也是一个训练环境，其中模型生成针对各种技能水平校准的问题。我们发现，即使是前沿模型在基准测试上的校准率也低于50%，这留下了显著的提升空间来衡量未来的进步。我们还表明，即使没有新的数学数据、没有与更强模型的交互以及没有基于正确性的奖励，在环境中进行训练也能在多个下游数学基准测试中取得改进。

articles.title: TRIBE: Predicting Team Performance via Communication Behavior Ensembles
articles.abstract: Designing autonomous agents that effectively assist human teams hinges on understanding team dynamics, often without task specific knowledge. We present TRIBE, a domain independent approach that reveals team behavioral dynamics invisible to traditional performance metrics. We show that communication patterns can categorize teams into performance predictive behavioral tribes, as early as 10% into the task, enabling timely interventions. We test TRIBE on four diverse datasets and demonstrate that communication patterns predict team performance while the prediction strength varies by the degree a task structure allows for behavioral freedom. Our temporal analysis reveals that AI agents significantly alter team behavioral trajectories while human advisors align with natural dynamics, and that teams maintain behavioral flexibility throughout collaboration. Further, we compare TRIBE to Llama and optimize the pipeline, achieving significant speedup with performance improvement.
articles.titleCn: 部落：通过沟通行为集成预测团队表现
articles.abstractCn: 设计能够有效协助人类团队的自主代理，关键在于理解团队动态，通常无需特定任务知识。我们提出了TRIBE，这是一种领域无关的方法，揭示了传统绩效指标无法显现的团队行为动态。我们证明，沟通模式可以在任务进行到10%时将团队分类为具有绩效预测性的行为部落，从而实现及时干预。我们在四个多样化的数据集上测试了TRIBE，并证明沟通模式能够预测团队绩效，而预测强度则因任务结构允许行为自由的程度而异。我们的时序分析表明，人工智能代理显著改变了团队行为轨迹，而人类顾问则与自然动态保持一致，并且团队在整个协作过程中保持了行为灵活性。此外，我们将TRIBE与Llama进行了比较，并优化了流程，实现了显著的速度提升和性能改进。

articles.title: Calibrating WEAT Against Anisotropy: ZCA Whitening as a Geometric Pre-Processing Step for Embedding Association Tests
articles.abstract: We propose Zero-phase Component Analysis (ZCA) whitening as a geometric pre-processing step for the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT). WEAT is a bias measurement method widely used in both computational social science and AI fairness research. It relies on cosine similarity as a measure of semantic association, which assumes that the embedding space is approximately isotropic. However, prior work has reported that many widely used language models do not satisfy this assumption, raising concerns about the reliability of bias measurements. ZCA whitening transforms the covariance of the embedding space into the identity matrix while minimizing perturbation to the original vectors. This transformation restores the isotropy condition on which WEAT relies. We evaluate our approach on ten standard WEAT test suites and seven models spanning three architectural families, yielding 70 model-task combinations. The results show that ZCA whitening substantially reduces the anisotropy of the embedding spaces across all models. Particularly for highly anisotropic models, we further observe improvements on standard semantic similarity benchmarks, indicating that the calibrated space better captures semantic associations. After calibration, over 30% of WEAT results change significance status, and effect sizes shift in both directions depending on bias category. These shifts suggest that uncalibrated measurements may both overestimate and underestimate the associations encoded in the embedding space. These findings indicate that previously reported bias measurements in anisotropic embedding spaces should be interpreted with caution and may benefit from re-evaluation with calibrated methods. Our approach contributes to restoring the measurement foundation of WEAT across both computational social science and AI fairness research.

articles.titleCn: 校准WEAT以对抗各向异性：ZCA白化为嵌入关联测试的几何预处理步骤
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出使用零相位分量分析（ZCA）白化作为词嵌入关联测试（WEAT）的几何预处理步骤。WEAT是一种广泛应用于计算社会科学和人工智能公平性研究的偏差测量方法。它依赖于余弦相似度作为语义关联的度量，该度量假设嵌入空间近似各向同性。然而，已有研究表明，许多广泛使用的语言模型并不满足这一假设，引发了关于偏差测量可靠性的担忧。ZCA白化将嵌入空间的协方差矩阵转换为单位矩阵，同时最小化对原始向量的扰动。这种转换恢复了WEAT所依赖的各向同性条件。我们在十个标准WEAT测试套件和七个跨越三种架构系列的模型上评估了我们的方法，共产生70个模型-任务组合。结果表明，ZCA白化显著降低了所有模型嵌入空间的各向异性。特别是对于高度各向异性的模型，我们进一步观察到在标准语义相似度基准上的改进，表明校准后的空间更好地捕捉了语义关联。校准后，超过30%的WEAT结果改变了显著性状态，效应量根据偏差类别向两个方向变化。这些变化表明，未校准的测量可能既高估又低估了嵌入空间中编码的关联。这些发现表明，先前在各向异性嵌入空间中报告的偏差测量应谨慎解读，并可能受益于使用校准方法的重新评估。我们的方法有助于恢复WEAT在计算社会科学和人工智能公平性研究中的测量基础。

articles.title: How Should I Pick a Foundation Model for My Robot? In Favor of a Community Evaluation Framework for Social Robots
articles.abstract: Researchers who seek to build social robot applications on foundation models are faced with a difficult question: how should we pick a model? Public leaderboards offer little guidance: the demands of real-time, embodied social interaction lie largely outside their focus. And direct evaluation is impractical at scale: each embodied study requires scarce participant, robot, and experimenter time. In this paper, we identify five evaluation dimensions for foundation models in social robots: (i) conversational competence, (ii) user safety, (iii) embodied character, (iv) target scene effectiveness, and (v) audience appropriateness. To make model selection cheaper and better informed, we propose a three-tiered evaluation funnel paradigm that first filters with general metrics, then extends to simulated interactions, and terminates in more expensive, robot-specific evaluation. We map all five dimensions across all three tiers, chart where applicable evaluation methods exist and are missing, and close with a call to action: let's build the evaluation framework together as a community.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the FoRMA workshop (Foundation Models in the RO-MAN Age: Responsible Development for Social Robotics) at IEEE RO-MAN 2026, Kitakyushu, Japan. Workshop homepage: https://sites.google.com/cam.ac.uk/forma/
articles.titleCn: 如何为我的机器人选择基础模型？支持为社交机器人建立社区评估框架
articles.abstractCn: 在构建基于基础模型的社会机器人应用的研究人员面临着这样一个难题：我们应该如何选择模型？公开的排行榜几乎无法提供指导：实时、具身化的社会互动需求在很大程度上超出了它们的关注范围。而直接评估在规模上是不切实际的：每个具身化研究都需要稀缺的参与者、机器人和实验者时间。在本文中，我们为社交机器人中的基础模型确定了五个评估维度：(i) 对话能力，(ii) 用户安全，(iii) 具身化特征，(iv) 目标场景有效性，以及 (v) 受众适宜性。为了使模型选择更经济、更明智，我们提出了一种三级评估漏斗范式，首先通过通用指标进行筛选，然后扩展到模拟互动，最终以更昂贵、特定于机器人的评估结束。我们将所有五个维度映射到三个层级中，标注了适用的评估方法及其缺失之处，并以行动号召结束：让我们作为一个社区共同构建评估框架。

articles.title: Georeferencing Non-Gazetteered Place Names using Biological Specimen Records
articles.abstract: Biological specimen records collected by natural history institutions constitute a rich source of temporal geographic knowledge, capturing biodiversity information about regional landscapes as they were recorded at different times. Using digitised data from the Allan Herbarium (New Zealand), this study identifies place names in these specimen locality descriptions that are absent from current gazetteers; we refer to these as non-gazetteer place names (NGPs). These place names are typically historical, vernacular, or colloquial and were used as landmarks to describe a specimen's location at the time of collection. We then investigate the problem of georeferencing the NGPs using only the limited information available in the specimen records. To resolve this, we leverage repeated occurrences of the same place name across specimen records with different specimen locations and spatial relation terms, extracting and inverting these relations to derive constraints on NGP locations. This approach is instantiated within deterministic, probabilistic, and LLM-based methods, enabling a comparative analysis of their strengths and limitations for text-based spatial inference. On a pseudo-NGP benchmark, probabilistic inference achieves the highest accuracy (median error 1.43 km; A@1 km 36%), while the LLM yields competitive but less precise estimates (median error 1.80 km; A@1 km 31%), indicating that, despite advances in LLMs, traditional modelling remains advantageous when high spatial precision is required.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the Conference on Spatial Information Theory (COSIT) 2026
articles.titleCn: 使用生物标本记录对未正式编录的地点名称进行地理配准
articles.abstractCn: 自然历史机构收集的生物学标本记录构成了丰富的时空地理知识来源，捕捉了不同时期记录的区域景观生物多样性信息。本研究利用新西兰阿兰植物标本馆的数字化数据，识别出当前公报中缺失的标本地点描述中的地名，我们将这些称为非公报地名（NGP）。这些地名通常是历史性的、口语化的或通俗的，当时用作地标来描述标本的采集位置。随后，我们研究了仅利用标本记录中有限信息对NGP进行地理定位的问题。为解决此问题，我们利用标本记录中相同地名的重复出现，结合不同的标本位置和空间关系术语，提取并反转这些关系，以推导出NGP位置的约束条件。该方法在确定性、概率性和基于LLM的方法中得以实现，从而对其在基于文本的空间推理中的优缺点进行比较分析。在一个伪NGP基准测试中，概率推理达到了最高精度（中位数误差1.43公里；A@1公里36%），而LLM则提供了具有竞争力但精度较低的估计（中位数误差1.80公里；A@1公里31%），表明尽管LLM取得了进步，但在需要高空间精度时，传统建模仍然具有优势。

articles.title: DAEP: Difficulty-Aware Evidence Planning for Medical Video Corpus Temporal Answer Grounding
articles.abstract: We describe DAEP, team BIGC's submission to NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 1 Track 3: Difficulty-Aware Temporal Answer Grounding in Video Corpus (DA-TAGVC). The task requires retrieving the target video from 50 candidates and localizing the answer-supporting span. DAEP ranks videos with subtitle, visual, and procedural-context evidence, expands high-scoring anchors into temporal spans, and reranks spans for final output. Its main design is to convert the task-provided simple/complex input label into an inference-time evidence plan controlling modality weights, Top-K aggregation, boundary threshold, expansion length, and reranking strength. In the official evaluation, BIGC ranks first among ten systems with an Average score of 0.2728. Validation ablations show that visual evidence, procedural context, and difficulty-aware planning improve ranking quality, with the largest gain on complex questions.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, accepted by NLPCC 2026 Shared Task Track 3
articles.titleCn: DAEP：面向医学视频语料库时序答案 grounding 的难度感知证据规划
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了DAEP，即BIGC团队提交给NLPCC 2026共享任务1第3赛道：视频语料库中的难度感知时序答案定位（DA-TAGVC）的解决方案。该任务要求从50个候选视频中检索目标视频，并定位支持答案的片段。DAEP通过字幕、视觉和程序性上下文证据对视频进行排序，将高得分锚点扩展为时序片段，并对片段进行重新排序以生成最终输出。其主要设计思想是将任务提供的简单/复杂输入标签转换为推理时证据计划，该计划控制模态权重、Top-K聚合、边界阈值、扩展长度和重新排序强度。在官方评估中，BIGC在十个系统中排名第一，平均得分为0.2728。验证消融实验表明，视觉证据、程序性上下文和难度感知规划提升了排序质量，其中复杂问题的提升最为显著。

articles.title: LLMRouter: Unified Infrastructure for Developing, Evaluating, and Deploying LLM Routers
articles.abstract: No single large language model (LLM) is optimal across all queries and budget constraints, making model routing essential for cost-effective deployment. Existing routers adopt diverse formulations and implementations, making fair comparison and extension difficult. We present a unified formulation of LLM routing as a sequential decision process characterized by five components: context encoders, model encoders, scoring functions, decision rules, and learning signals, covering single-turn, multi-turn, and personalized routing. Based on this formulation, we develop an automated pipeline for constructing routing supervision and evaluating routers jointly on response quality and inference cost. The resulting benchmark, xRouteBench, spans generic LLM, memory-augmented, vision, time-series, and personalized routing tasks. We further introduce LLMRouter, an open-source modular infrastructure with more than 16 representative routers. Our empirical study shows that learned routers outperform the strongest fixed-model baseline by 14.6% relatively, lightweight routers become more competitive under tight cost constraints, and user-conditioned routing consistently improves personalization.
articles.titleCn: LLMRouter：用于开发、评估和部署LLM路由器的统一基础设施
articles.abstractCn: 没有单一的、适用于所有查询和预算约束的大型语言模型（LLM）是最佳的，这使得模型路由对于成本效益部署至关重要。现有的路由器采用不同的公式和实现方式，使得公平比较和扩展变得困难。我们提出了一个将LLM路由统一为具有五个组件的序列决策过程公式：上下文编码器、模型编码器、评分函数、决策规则和学习信号，涵盖了单轮、多轮和个性化路由。基于此公式，我们开发了一个自动化的管道，用于构建路由监督，并在响应质量和推理成本上联合评估路由器。由此产生的基准测试xRouteBench涵盖了通用LLM、记忆增强、视觉、时间序列和个性化路由任务。我们进一步引入了LLMRouter，这是一个包含16个以上代表性路由器的开源模块化基础设施。我们的实证研究表明，学习型路由器相较于最强的固定模型基线提高了14.6%的相对性能，轻量级路由器在严格的成本约束下更具竞争力，而用户条件路由始终提升了个性化效果。

articles.title: Autonomy-of-Heads: Data-Free Sparse Attention from Frozen Query-Key Geometry
articles.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by quadratic attention computation and growing KV-cache costs. Existing sparse attention and KV-compression methods typically decide which tokens or heads to preserve from runtime attention scores, observation windows, calibration prompts, or learned gates, making head diagnosis input-dependent and costly to deploy. We propose Autonomy-of-Heads (AoH), a data-free method that identifies retrieval and streaming heads from the spectral geometry of query-key projections. AoH defines the kernel attention operator $M_h = W_K^{h\top}W_Q^h$ and uses its effective-rank as a weight-space measure of head function: concentrated spectra indicate a small number of dominant query-key matching directions and are associated with retrieval heads, whereas diffuse spectra indicate the absence of a dominant global matching direction and are associated with streaming heads. We further derive an efficient $d_\text{head}$-dimensional computation that avoids constructing the full $d_\text{model}\times d_\text{model}$ matrix. We conducted extensive experiments across models demonstrating that at 50\% sparsity, AoH retains 96.5\% of Full Attention performance on average while reducing prefill and decode latency by up to 41.4\% and 66.0\%, respectively, and KV-cache memory by 50.0\% at 256K tokens.
articles.titleCn: 自主性：基于冻结查询-键几何的无数据稀疏注意力
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文大语言模型推理受到二次方注意力计算和不断增长的KV缓存成本的瓶颈。现有的稀疏注意力和KV压缩方法通常根据运行时注意力分数、观测窗口、校准提示或学习门来决定保留哪些token或注意力头，这使得头诊断依赖于输入且部署成本高昂。我们提出了头自主性（Autonomy-of-Heads，简称AoH），这是一种无需数据的检索和流式传输头识别方法，它从查询-键投影的频谱几何结构中识别这些头。AoH定义了核注意力算子$M_h = W_K^{h\top}W_Q^h$，并使用其有效秩作为头功能的权重空间度量：集中的频谱表明存在少数主导的查询-键匹配方向，并与检索头相关联；而弥散的频谱表明不存在主导的全局匹配方向，并与流式传输头相关联。我们进一步推导了一种高效的$d_\text{head}$维计算方法，避免了构建完整的$d_\text{model}\times d_\text{model}$矩阵。我们在多个模型上进行了广泛的实验，结果表明，在50%稀疏度下，AoH平均保留了96.5%的完整注意力性能，同时将预填充和解码延迟分别降低了41.4%和66.0%，并将256K token的KV缓存内存降低了50.0%。

articles.title: FutureBridge: Token Selection Beyond Local Preference in Collaborative Decoding
articles.abstract: Token-level collaboration allows a large language model (LLM) to assist a small language model (SLM) when their predictions diverge. Existing methods either use LLM-generated intervention tokens or rank candidates with the LLM's next-token probabilities. Both rely on the LLM's local preference, even though an LLM-selected token may be difficult for the SLM to build on. We present FutureBridge, which ranks joint LLM-SLM token candidates according to how well they support the SLM's subsequent reasoning. During training, an answer-verified LLM trajectory supplies a fixed shared future, and a frozen SLM evaluates every candidate under this common context. The resulting counterfactual scores supervise a lightweight token reranker that observes only the current state and candidate token. At inference, FutureBridge uses the LLM only to expand the candidate pool, selects one token, and returns generation to the SLM without generating or appending a future suffix. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FutureBridge improves the Qwen3-1.7B SLM's Math Avg. by 35.1% relative to greedy SLM decoding. These results indicate that token selection benefits from modeling whether the receiving SLM can use each candidate to continue reasoning, rather than relying on the LLM's local preference alone.
articles.titleCn: FutureBridge：协作解码中的超越本地偏好的代币选择
articles.abstractCn: 基于token的协作允许大型语言模型（LLM）在小型语言模型（SLM）预测出现分歧时为其提供协助。现有方法或使用LLM生成的干预token，或通过LLM的下一个token概率对候选进行排序。尽管LLM选择的token可能对SLM难以构建，但两者都依赖于LLM的局部偏好。我们提出了FutureBridge，它根据联合LLM-SLM token候选如何支持SLM后续推理来对其进行排序。在训练期间，一个经过答案验证的LLM轨迹提供了一个固定的共享未来，而一个冻结的SLM在这个共同环境下评估每个候选。由此产生的反事实分数监督一个仅观察当前状态和候选token的轻量级token重排序器。在推理时，FutureBridge仅使用LLM来扩展候选池，选择一个token，并将生成返回给SLM，而无需生成或附加未来后缀。在五个数学推理基准测试中，FutureBridge相对于贪婪SLM解码，将Qwen3-1.7B SLM的数学平均性能提高了35.1%。这些结果表明，token选择受益于建模接收的SLM是否能够使用每个候选继续推理，而不仅仅是依赖LLM的局部偏好。

articles.title: Simple-OPD: Demystifying Warm-up for On-policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from teacher models, but its effectiveness can depend strongly on the warm-up stage before OPD. In this paper, we demystify warm-up for OPD from both data and training perspectives. For data, we find that effective warm-up relies on teacher-compatible chain-of-thought supervision, and that even incorrect teacher rollouts can provide comparable benefits to correct ones. This suggests that warm-up primarily transfers a teacher-compatible thinking pattern rather than merely correct answers. For training, we show that low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with a near-saturation training duration better balances in-domain adaptation and out-of-distribution generalization than full-parameter SFT. Based on these findings, we propose Simple-OPD, a plug-and-play initialization method that warms up the student on teacher-generated CoT with LoRA before OPD. Experiments across diverse settings demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Simple-OPD.
articles.titleCn: 简单OPD：揭秘策略内蒸馏的预热
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过教师模型的token级监督在自身运行中训练学生模型，但其有效性很大程度上取决于OPD之前的预热阶段。在本文中，我们从数据和训练两个角度揭示了OPD预热的奥秘。从数据角度看，我们发现有效的预热依赖于与教师模型兼容的思维链监督，即使错误的教师运行也能提供与正确运行相当的好处。这表明预热主要传递的是与教师模型兼容的思维模式，而不仅仅是正确答案。从训练角度看，我们表明具有接近饱和训练时长的低秩适配（LoRA）比全参数SFT更好地平衡了领域内适应和领域外泛化。基于这些发现，我们提出了Simple-OPD，这是一种即插即用的初始化方法，在OPD之前使用LoRA在教师生成的思维链上进行预热。跨多种设置进行的实验证明了Simple-OPD的有效性和鲁棒性。

articles.title: LoRAScan: Detecting Backdoor Prompts in Low-Rank Adapters for Large Language Models via Down-Projection Activation Spikes
articles.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization and distribution of large language models through compact adapters. However, untrusted adapters introduce a supply-chain threat: a backdoored adapter can cause a model to generate harmful content, malicious code, political propaganda, or covert advertisements when an input contains a hidden trigger. Adapter-agnostic defenses merge the adapter with the base model, which dilutes backdoor signals and reduces detection performance. Existing adapter-aware methods do not address how to safely use a potentially backdoored adapter. Instead, they either train a defensive adapter to repair a backdoored base model, addressing the inverse problem rather than securing the adapter itself, or rely on a classifier that flags the entire adapter as suspicious and requires separate mitigation. These methods overlook the distinct latent-space signatures produced by trigger-bearing inputs in backdoored adapters. We introduce LoRAScan, the first adapter-aware defense that detects and rejects trigger-bearing inputs at inference time without modifying adapter parameters. Our key observation is that a small subset of LoRA insertion sites, approximately 5%, remains stable across clean inputs but exhibits highly concentrated spikes in LoRA down-projection activations when a trigger is present. LoRAScan identifies these low-variance insertion sites before model deployment and monitors them during inference. Across standard LLM backdoor benchmarks, LoRAScan rejects approximately 98.49 of malicious inputs with a small error rate on clean inputs, outperforming existing defenses across diverse evaluation settings.
articles.titleCn: LoRAScan：通过下投影激活尖峰检测大型语言模型低秩适配器中的后门提示
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配（LoRA）通过紧凑的适配器实现了大型语言模型的效率特化和分布式部署。然而，不可信的适配器引入了供应链威胁：一个后门适配器会在输入包含隐藏触发器时，使模型生成有害内容、恶意代码、政治宣传或隐蔽广告。适配器无关防御将适配器与基础模型合并，这会稀释后门信号并降低检测性能。现有的适配器感知方法并未解决如何安全使用可能存在后门的适配器的问题。它们要么训练一个防御性适配器来修复后门基础模型，这解决的是逆问题而非适配器本身的保护；要么依赖一个分类器将整个适配器标记为可疑，并需要单独的缓解措施。这些方法忽略了后门适配器中由触发输入产生的独特潜在空间特征。我们引入了LoRAScan，这是首个在推理时无需修改适配器参数即可检测并拒绝含触发器的输入的适配器感知防御方法。我们的关键观察是，LoRA插入点的极小子集（约5%）在干净输入下保持稳定，但在存在触发器时，其LoRA下投影激活表现出高度集中的尖峰。LoRAScan在模型部署前识别这些低方差插入点，并在推理过程中进行监控。在标准的LLM后门基准测试中，LoRAScan拒绝约98.49%的恶意输入，对干净输入的误报率较低，在多种评估设置下优于现有防御方法。

articles.title: Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network for Cognitive Distortion Detection
articles.abstract: Cognitive distortion detection is a key task in computational mental health, yet existing approaches often overlook the psychological structure of distorted thoughts. We propose MTI-GNN (Multi-Perspective Triad Interaction Graph Neural Network), which models Beck's cognitive triad---negative views of the self, world, and future---as complementary perspectives for classification. An LLM decomposes each utterance into the three perspectives, from which perspective-specific similarity graphs are constructed and encoded by a Multi-Perspective GNN. A Triad Interaction module models cross-perspective dependencies through sequential source-conditioned updates and feature-wise gating, while Prototype-Guided Perspective Fusion performs label-conditioned aggregation. Label-expanded supervision incorporates all available distortion annotations during training. We evaluate MTI-GNN on 9,764 samples from four Korean, English, and Chinese datasets spanning ten distortion categories. MTI-GNN significantly outperforms all supervised variants and exceeds eight prompted generative models under zero-shot and few-shot settings. Leave-one-perspective-out ablations show that all three perspectives contribute significantly, while human expert evaluation provides preliminary evidence of their alignment with the intended cognitive dimensions.
articles.titleCn: 多视角三元组交互图神经网络用于认知扭曲检测
articles.abstractCn: 认知偏差检测是计算心理健康领域的一项关键任务，但现有方法往往忽略了扭曲思维的心理学结构。我们提出了MTI-GNN（多视角三元交互图神经网络），该模型将贝克的认知三元组——对自我、世界和未来的负面看法——建模为分类的互补视角。一个大型语言模型将每个话语分解为三个视角，并构建视角特定的相似度图，由多视角图神经网络进行编码。三元交互模块通过序列源条件更新和特征门控来模拟跨视角依赖，而原型引导视角融合执行标签条件聚合。标签扩展监督在训练过程中整合了所有可用的偏差标注。我们在涵盖十个偏差类别的四个韩语、英语和中文数据集的9,764个样本上评估了MTI-GNN。MTI-GNN显著优于所有监督变体，并在零样本和少样本设置下超过八个提示生成模型。留一个视角不参与的消融实验表明，所有三个视角都做出了显著贡献，而人类专家评估初步证明了它们与预期认知维度的吻合。

articles.title: Genotypic Triggers: Exposing Pharmacogenomic Blind Spots via Host-Specific Backdoors in Generative Antimicrobial Peptide Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated drug discovery, particularly in the automated design of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs). However, current validation pipelines for peptide generation models overlook historical precedents showing that certain drugs carry health risks predominantly for individuals with specific genetic profiles. In this paper, we demonstrate that such targeted health risks can be induced intentionally and at scale by manipulating models that generate peptide candidates. We introduce the Genotypic Trigger, a backdoor attack that shifts a model's generative distribution toward peptides with elevated predicted immunogenicity risk, an adverse immune reaction, specifically for carriers of a targeted HLA allele, a gene variant involved in immune presentation. Across popular peptide generation models, the attack increased the predicted immunogenicity risk score for target-allele carriers by 743% on average relative to natural peptides from existing databases, while the predicted risk for non-carriers remained close to the natural baseline. Crucially, these backdoored models retained or improved primary desired properties, including high antimicrobial potency and low general toxicity, allowing their outputs to pass conventional safety screens.
articles.titleCn: 表型触发器：通过生成抗菌肽模型中的宿主特异性后门揭示药效基因组盲点
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）加速了药物发现进程，特别是在抗菌肽（AMPs）的自动化设计方面。然而，当前用于肽生成模型的验证流程忽视了历史先例，这些先例表明某些药物对具有特定基因特征的人群健康风险尤为突出。本文我们证明，通过操纵生成肽候选物的模型，可以有意且大规模地诱导此类靶向健康风险。我们引入了基因型触发器（Genotypic Trigger），这是一种后门攻击，使模型的生成分布向具有高预测免疫原性风险的肽转移，这是一种针对携带特定HLA等位基因（一种参与免疫呈递的基因变异）的个体的不良免疫反应。在流行的肽生成模型中，该攻击使目标等位基因携带者的预测免疫原性风险评分平均比现有数据库中的天然肽提高了743%，而非携带者的预测风险则接近自然基线。关键在于，这些被植入后门的模型保留了或改进了主要期望特性，包括高抗菌活性和低一般毒性，使其输出能够通过传统安全筛查。

articles.title: Retrieval-Constrained Policy Optimization for Attack Technique Extraction from Cyber Threat Intelligence
articles.abstract: Mapping cyber threat intelligence (CTI) text to MITRE ATT&CK techniques is essential for structured threat analysis, yet manual annotation is costly and does not scale. The ATT&CK taxonomy comprises several hundred attack techniques, and a single CTI passage may describe multiple techniques, making accurate and complete extraction challenging. Existing automated approaches fall short in different ways: multi-label classifiers struggle with severe class imbalance and the large label space, while LLM-based methods--retrieval pipelines and fine-tuned generators--optimize token-level objectives that treat technique annotation as sequence generation rather than set prediction, lacking direct supervision on whether the predicted technique set is correct and complete. We propose TTP-R1, a two-stage framework that combines retrieval-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards (RLVR). A hybrid retriever first narrows the large label space to a candidate set, and a fine-tuned LLM learns to select the correct techniques. We then apply Group Relative Policy Optimization with a decomposed reward that directly supervises the precision, recall, and output format of the predicted technique set. Across four CTI benchmarks, TTP-R1 achieves the best average F1, improving sub-technique-level F1 by 7.4 percentage points over Claude Sonnet 4.5 with retrieval augmentation, while running 28x faster when served as an 8B-parameter model on a single GPU.

articles.titleCn: 基于检索约束的策略优化：从网络威胁情报中提取攻击技术
articles.abstractCn: 将网络威胁情报（CTI）文本映射到MITRE ATT&CK技术对于结构化威胁分析至关重要，但手动标注成本高昂且无法扩展。ATT&CK分类体系包含数百种攻击技术，单个CTI段落可能描述多种技术，使得准确和完整的提取极具挑战性。现有自动化方法各有不足：多标签分类器难以处理严重的类别不平衡和庞大的标签空间，而基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法——检索管道和微调生成器——优化了token级别的目标，将技术标注视为序列生成而非集合预测，缺乏对预测技术集合是否正确和完整的直接监督。我们提出了TTP-R1，一个两阶段框架，结合了检索增强的监督微调（SFT）与使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。混合检索器首先将庞大的标签空间缩小为候选集，微调的LLM学习选择正确的技术。随后，我们应用了分组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization），使用分解的奖励直接监督预测技术集合的精确率、召回率和输出格式。在四个CTI基准测试中，TTP-R1实现了最佳平均F1值，相较于使用检索增强的Claude Sonnet 4.5，在子技术级别F1上提升了7.4个百分点，同时在单GPU上作为8B参数模型部署时运行速度提高了28倍。

articles.title: Stockmark-Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-JapanDocReader: Structured Document Parsing via Capability Injection and Forgetting Control
articles.abstract: We present Stockmark-Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-JapanDocReader, a Japanese document understanding model built from Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16. The central goal of this work is structured document parsing via capability injection and forgetting control: we inject Japanese structured document parsing capability into a reasoning-oriented multimodal model while preserving its document VQA capability as much as possible. We study parsing-centric SFT, which uses only structured document parsing data; mixed SFT, which combines structured document parsing and VQA data; and parsing-centric RL, which optimizes structured parsing with a task-level reward. Our experiments show that parsing-centric SFT substantially improves structured document parsing performance but causes measurable VQA forgetting. Mixed SFT mitigates this forgetting while preserving nearly the same structured parsing performance. Applying DAPO-based parsing-centric RL on top of the mixed SFT checkpoint further improves structured document parsing beyond the SFT ceiling, producing the final released model. The training data is constructed with a data engine consisting of two complementary synthetic streams: a Japanese Document VQA Stream and a programmatic structured document parsing stream. We also discuss reward design and variance-based prompt filtering for continuous structured document parsing rewards, highlighting their importance for making RL effective in long-reasoning structured document parsing tasks.
articles.titleCn: Stockmark-Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-JapanDocReader：通过能力注入和遗忘控制进行结构化文档解析
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了Stockmark-Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-JapanDocReader，这是一个基于Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16构建的日语文档理解模型。这项工作的核心目标是通过能力注入和遗忘控制实现结构化文档解析：我们将结构化文档解析能力注入到以推理为导向的多模态模型中，同时尽可能保留其文档问答（VQA）能力。我们研究了以解析为中心的监督微调（SFT），该微调仅使用结构化文档解析数据；混合SFT，该微调结合了结构化文档解析和VQA数据；以及以解析为中心的强化学习（RL），该学习通过任务级奖励优化结构化解析。我们的实验表明，以解析为中心的SFT显著提高了结构化文档解析性能，但导致了可测量的VQA遗忘。混合SFT缓解了这种遗忘，同时保持了几乎相同的结构化解析性能。在混合SFT检查点上应用基于DAPO的以解析为中心的RL，进一步将结构化文档解析性能提升至SFT上限，最终生成了发布的模型。训练数据是通过一个由两个互补合成流组成的数据引擎构建的：日语文档VQA流和程序化结构化文档解析流。我们还讨论了基于方差的提示过滤，用于连续结构化文档解析奖励的设计，并强调了它们在使RL在长推理结构化文档解析任务中有效方面的重要性。

articles.title: Mind the Gap: A Dual Knowledge Graph Framework for Unified Multi-task User Intent Inference
articles.abstract: This paper proposes DKG-MTI, a dual knowledge graph framework for unified multi-task user intent inference from online travel reviews. Existing approaches often rely on hierarchical pipelines that suffer from error propagation or retrieval methods that ignore structural relationships in domain knowledge. To address these limitations, we introduce an inference-only knowledge augmentation framework that dynamically constructs a User-Specific Intent Knowledge Graph from each review and aligns it with a Global Hotel Knowledge Graph through structure-aware semantic smoothing. The aligned knowledge is combined with the original review and processed by a large language model to simultaneously predict aspect ratings and generate reverse user intent statements. Experiments on TripAdvisor reviews show that DKG-MTI consistently outperforms strong LLM and retrieval-based baselines in both classification and intent generation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware knowledge alignment for scalable and explainable intent inference.

articles.titleCn: 注意间隙：一种用于统一多任务用户意图推理的双重知识图谱框架
articles.abstractCn: 本文提出了一种名为DKG-MTI的双知识图谱框架，用于从在线旅游评论中进行统一的跨任务用户意图推理。现有方法通常依赖于分层流水线，存在错误传播问题，或采用忽略领域知识结构关系的检索方法。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了一个仅用于推理的知识增强框架，该框架从每条评论中动态构建用户特定意图知识图谱，并通过结构感知语义平滑将其与全局酒店知识图谱进行对齐。对齐后的知识被与原始评论结合，并由大型语言模型进行处理，以同时预测方面评分并生成反向用户意图陈述。在TripAdvisor评论上的实验表明，DKG-MTI在分类和意图生成任务中均持续优于强大的LLM和基于检索的基线模型，证明了结构感知知识对齐在可扩展和可解释意图推理中的有效性。

articles.title: Progressive Content Refinement with Decaying Reward Joint LinUCB
articles.abstract: Iterative refinement has significantly enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) performance; however, existing methods ranging from feedback-based Self-Refine to traditional bandit approaches often rely on static options or overlook the saturation effect. This neglect leads to over-exploitation, where the continuous use of identical prompts or arms results in diminishing rewards over time. To address this challenge, we propose a novel contextual bandit algorithm that explicitly incorporates reward decay modeling. Utilizing an Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, our method simultaneously estimates both arm-specific and decay parameters. Furthermore, by embedding prompts as arms, we facilitate the joint learning of arm values, distinguishing our approach from the traditional disjoint Linear Upper Confidence Bound (LinUCB) framework. Experimental results on Sentiment Reversal and GSM8K benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves significant performance gains over strong baselines. Finally, our ablation study confirms that the integration of reward decay modeling within the bandit framework is crucial for mitigating over-exploitation and optimizing the iterative refinement process.
articles.titleCn: 衰减奖励联合LinUCB的渐进式内容优化
articles.abstractCn: 迭代优化显著提升了大型语言模型（LLM）的性能；然而，现有的从基于反馈的自我优化到传统多臂老虎机方法，通常依赖于静态选项或忽略了饱和效应。这种忽视导致过度探索，即持续使用相同的提示或臂会导致奖励随时间递减。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新的上下文多臂老虎机算法，明确地整合了奖励衰减建模。利用期望最大化（EM）算法，我们的方法同时估计了特定臂和衰减参数。此外，通过将提示嵌入为臂，我们促进了臂值的联合学习，使我们的方法区别于传统的分离线性置信上下界（LinUCB）框架。在情感反转和GSM8K基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在强基线之上实现了显著的性能提升。最后，我们的消融研究证实，在多臂老虎机框架中整合奖励衰减建模对于缓解过度探索和优化迭代优化过程至关重要。

articles.title: IB-RL: Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Dialogue Agents
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong results in improving large language models (LLMs) on tasks with stationary, verifiable rewards, such as mathematical reasoning and code execution. In these settings, the environment follows fixed rules and does not adapt strategically to the agent. Strategic dialogue differs in this respect: the environment is another agent that adapts to the policy, and success depends on the interaction between the two sides. Despite this interactive nature, current RL approaches typically train a target agent against a fixed counterpart or simulator. We find that this training paradigm encourages the policy to exploit counterpart-specific regularities rather than learn strategies that generalize across counterparts. We call this problem the static-counterpart mismatch, which we quantify directly in our experiments. To address it, we propose Isolated Bilateral Reinforcement Learning (IB-RL), in which the two roles coevolve through joint rollouts while each role optimizes its own reward through fully independent advantages, action masks, and update paths. We evaluate frozen policies against fully independent held-out counterparts in both domains. On Vehicle TeleSales, IB-RL achieves 89.6% Success@1, compared to 84.6% for the best unilateral RL baseline. On Deal-or-NoDeal, it reaches 98.4% agreement against DeepSeek V4 Pro, compared to 86.4% for the best unilateral baseline. These results indicate that jointly training both roles with strict peragent isolation produces policies that generalize more effectively to unseen counterparts.
articles.titleCn: IB-RL：针对策略对话代理的隔离双边强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在改进具有稳定、可验证奖励的大型语言模型（LLM）方面取得了显著成果，例如数学推理和代码执行任务。在这些场景中，环境遵循固定规则，不会对智能体采取策略性适应。而策略性对话则不同：环境是另一个会根据策略进行适应的智能体，成功取决于双方之间的交互。尽管具有交互性，当前的RL方法通常是在固定对手或模拟器上训练目标智能体。我们发现这种训练范式会促使策略利用特定对手的规律性，而不是学习跨对手泛化的策略。我们将此问题称为静态对手不匹配，并在实验中直接对其进行了量化。为解决此问题，我们提出了隔离双边强化学习（IB-RL），其中两个角色通过联合运行共同进化，同时每个角色通过完全独立的优势、动作掩码和更新路径优化自己的奖励。我们在两个领域中对冻结的策略与完全独立的保留对手进行了评估。在车辆远程销售（Vehicle TeleSales）中，IB-RL达到了89.6%的Success@1，而最佳单边RL基线为84.6%。在Deal-or-NoDeal中，它达到了98.4%的协议率，而最佳单边基线为86.4%。这些结果表明，通过严格按智能体隔离共同训练两个角色，可以产生更有效地泛化到未见过的对手的策略。

articles.title: Do Audio Language Models Use Paralinguistic Evidence? Counterfactual Audits for Response Evaluation
articles.abstract: Audio-language models (ALMs) are increasingly used as judges for speech-to-speech systems, but a judge that receives audio may not actually use paralinguistic evidence. We introduce counterfactual audits for paralinguistic response evaluation. Each audit item holds the transcript fixed while varying affect, prosody, or the timing of an affective shift, forcing a valid judge to track the audio cue rather than lexical content or response style. We evaluate ALM judges using a native one-context judgment protocol and a contrastive recoverability control, then further decompose each item into its constituent perception and response-mapping skills. This yields useful diagnostic states that identify different sources of judge failures. Across Gemini, GPT, and open audio models, we find that contrastive success often overstates native judge reliability, and that similar aggregate accuracies can hide different failure modes. These results suggest that ALM judges should not be evaluated by accuracy alone, instead requiring thorough behavioral audits before deployment.
articles.titleCn: 音频语言模型是否使用副语言证据？用于响应评估的对照检查
articles.abstractCn: 语音语言模型（ALM）越来越多地被用作语音转语音系统的评判者，但一个接收音频的评判者可能并不会实际使用副语言证据。我们引入了针对副语言响应评估的对照性审计。每个审计项固定文本内容，同时改变情感、韵律或情感转变的时机，迫使有效的评判者跟踪音频线索而非词汇内容或响应风格。我们使用本地单语境评判协议和对比性可恢复性控制来评估ALM评判者，然后进一步将每个项目分解为其构成感知和响应映射技能。这产生了有用的诊断状态，能够识别评判者失败的来源。在Gemini、GPT和开放音频模型中，我们发现对比性成功往往高估了本地评判者的可靠性，并且相似的总体准确率可能掩盖了不同的失败模式。这些结果表明，ALM评判者不应仅通过准确率来评估，而是在部署前需要进行彻底的行为审计。

articles.title: Online Monitoring and Corrective Steering of Programming Agents
articles.abstract: Fixing GitHub issues in large-scale projects is a long-horizon task, especially when a fix requires changes across multiple locations or the issue description lacks the information needed to localize and repair it. As a result, agents traverse long trajectories that are prone to inefficiency and error: they drift away from their intended plan, repeat failed actions, or terminate without a working patch. This paper proposes LivePlan to monitor, detect, and correct such behavioral inefficiencies and drifts in real time. LivePlan decouples judging from advising: a deterministic, rule-based monitor examines general signals over the trajectory to detect issues without invoking an LLM, and only when an issue is detected does it consult an advisor LLM for a high-level, next-step correction. This design avoids the misleading re-planning and costly interventions of prior approaches. We implement LivePlan on top of SWE-agent and evaluate it using five LLMs (three as executor agents and two as advisors) across SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. Compared to vanilla SWE-agent, LivePlan notably improves issue resolution rates, achieving consistent gains of up to 15.2% (average: 9.9%), while incurring only an additional cost of $0.08 per instance. The additional solutions concentrate on medium and hard instances. LivePlan consistently outperforms alternative approaches in resolution rate, with minimal regression on already successful runs and new successes on problems that no baseline solves.
articles.titleCn: 编程智能体的在线监控与纠正转向
articles.abstractCn: 在大型项目中修复GitHub问题是一项长期任务，尤其是在修复需要跨多个位置进行更改，或问题描述缺乏本地化和修复所需信息的情况下。因此，代理会经历长距离轨迹，容易导致低效和错误：它们偏离预期计划，重复失败的操作，或在没有有效补丁的情况下终止。本文提出了LivePlan来实时监控、检测和纠正此类行为低效和偏离。LivePlan将判断与建议解耦：一个确定性、基于规则的监控器检查轨迹中的通用信号以检测问题，而无需调用LLM，只有当检测到问题时，才会咨询顾问LLM以获得高级别、下一步的纠正。这种设计避免了先前方法的误导性重新规划和昂贵干预。我们在SWE-agent之上实现了LivePlan，并使用五个LLM（其中三个作为执行代理，两个作为顾问）在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro上评估它。与普通的SWE-agent相比，LivePlan显著提高了问题解决率，实现了高达15.2%（平均9.9%）的持续增益，而每实例仅增加成本0.08美元。额外的解决方案主要集中在中等和困难实例上。LivePlan在解决率方面始终优于替代方法，对已成功运行的实例几乎没有回归，并在基线无法解决的问题上取得了新的成功。

articles.title: TA-RAG: Tone Awareness as a Design Imperative for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a robust architecture for grounding large language models (LLMs) in trusted knowledge. However, standard RAG systems exhibit a structural limitation: retrieved documents carry their own communication styles-professional jargon, formal tone, or academic writings-that shape the behavior of a RAG system before any tone instructions are processed, often causing the system to ignore user requests for a specific tone. We term this phenomenon contextual decoupling, in which a system optimises for factual accuracy while remaining decoupled from the social or operational context of the recipient. Building on prior research in public health peer-support communities, we identify three communicative misalignment-linguistic, cognitive, and relational-that can persist even when retrieval is relevant and the generated response is factually accurate. We conceptualise these as failures of communicative transformation, which remain largely invisible to accuracy-centred RAG evaluation metrics. To address this gap, we propose Tone-Aware RAG (TA-RAG), a conceptual architectural framework that positions communicative alignment alongside factual accuracy as a core design objective. TA-RAG operationalises four constraints-stigma-free language, readability alignment, recipient-sensitive adaptation, and empathetic framing-across the retrieval, context construction, generation, and constraint validation phases in the proposed RAG pipeline. We further highlight an evaluation agenda for jointly assessing factual fidelity and communicative alignment, and identify open challenges. We argue that tone awareness should be treated not as an optional refinement, but as a present design imperative for RAG systems operating in socially sensitive and high-stakes contexts.
articles.titleCn: TA-RAG：将语调意识作为检索增强生成的设计要务
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为将大型语言模型（LLM）锚定在可信知识上的强大架构。然而，标准RAG系统存在结构性局限：检索到的文档具有其自身的沟通风格——专业术语、正式语气或学术写作——这些风格在处理任何语气指令之前就塑造了RAG系统的行为，常常导致系统忽略用户对特定语气的请求。我们将这种现象称为情境解耦，即系统优化事实准确性，同时与社会或操作接收者的背景脱节。基于先前对公共卫生同伴支持社区的研究，我们识别出三种沟通错位——语言、认知和关系——即使检索相关且生成响应在事实上准确，这些错位仍可能持续存在。我们将这些概念化为沟通转换失败，而以准确性为中心的RAG评估指标对此基本无感知。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了语气感知RAG（TA-RAG），这是一个概念性架构框架，将沟通一致性置于事实准确性同等重要的核心设计目标。TA-RAG在检索、上下文构建、生成和约束验证等RAG管道的各个阶段，将四个约束——无污名化语言、可读性一致性、接收者敏感适应和共情框架——具体化。我们进一步强调了一个联合评估事实准确性和沟通一致性的评估议程，并指出了开放性挑战。我们认为，语气感知不应被视为可选的改进，而是对于在社会敏感和高风险环境中运行的RAG系统而言，当前的设计要求。

articles.title: The Horizon Gap: Planning, Memory, Execution, Training, and Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Frontier language models solve reasoning problems in a single forward pass that would have been research contributions years ago, yet fail at multi-hour tasks: losing track of earlier decisions, declaring half-finished work done, or drifting from goals. We call this the horizon gap and survey 1,547 arXiv papers (2024-2026) collected via systematic seed harvest with a disclosed 26.8% bleed filter, extended by targeted supplementation. We disambiguate three routinely conflated properties: long-horizon (task property: required steps), long-context (model property: token capacity), and long-term memory (system property: persistence across steps/sessions). We organize the corpus into six categories tracking a long-horizon task's lifecycle -- planning, memory, execution, training, evaluation, and foundations/safety -- crossed with an axis capturing where horizons are carried (within-context, within-task-beyond-context, or cross-task-persistent). Across all categories, we find the same pattern: outcome-only signals grow uninformative as horizons lengthen, and the field's response -- whether process reward models, credit assignment, or trajectory-level diagnostics -- manufactures denser step-level signals. We treat critical and diagnostic literature as first-class threads throughout, arguing that segregating critique from method would routinely split single papers across chapters. We close by naming open measurement problems: decomposing model versus harness capability, managing correlated bias in process-level signals used for both training and evaluation, and whether long-horizon reliability admits general predictive theory.

articles.titleCn: 时间跨度差距：长时程大型语言模型代理的规划、记忆、执行、训练与评估
articles.abstractCn: 前沿语言模型能在单次前向传递中解决过去需要研究贡献的推理问题，但在多小时的复杂任务中却表现不佳：它们会忘记早期的决策、宣告未完成的工作已完成，或偏离目标。我们将这种现象称为“视野差距”，并调查了通过系统性种子采集（含公开26.8%泄漏过滤）收集的1,547篇arXiv论文（2024-2026年），并进行了有针对性的补充。我们区分了三个通常被混淆的特性：长视野（任务属性：所需步骤）、长上下文（模型属性：标记容量）和长期记忆（系统属性：跨步骤/会话的持久性）。我们将语料库分为六个类别，追踪长视野任务的生命周期——规划、记忆、执行、训练、评估和基础/安全——并与一个轴交叉，该轴捕捉视野的承载位置（上下文中、任务内超越上下文、跨任务持久）。在所有类别中，我们发现相同模式：随着视野的延长，仅结果信号变得无信息，而该领域的回应——无论是过程奖励模型、归因分配还是轨迹级诊断——制造了更密集的步骤级信号。我们将关键和诊断文献视为贯穿始终的一流线索，认为将批评与方法分离会导致单篇论文常规地分散到不同章节。最后，我们命名了开放测量问题：分解模型与 harness 能力的差异、管理用于训练和评估的过程级信号中的相关偏差，以及长视野可靠性是否允许一般预测理论。

articles.title: DevIntent: How Much Does LLM-Generated Code Violate Developer Intent?
articles.abstract: Code generated by LLMs can violate a developer's implicit intentions when given an ambiguous prompt, yet standard benchmarks measure only whether code passes its stated test. We introduce the Intent Violation Rate (IVR) and a 49-problem pilot benchmark derived from HumanEval+. Each problem strips implicit constraints from a clarified prompt and encodes them as hidden constraint tests. IVR measures the fraction of LLM-generated solutions that pass the stated (visible) tests yet fail hidden constraint tests that capture unstated intent. Evaluating Claude Sonnet 4.6 and OpenAI GPT 4.1, we find both pass over 92\% of stated tests yet violate intent in over half of problems (54.5\% and 63.5\%), following a systematic, bimodal pattern consistent across both models. Out findings indicate that pass rates overstate how well generated code reflects developer intent.

articles.titleCn: DevIntent：LLM生成的代码违反开发者意图的程度如何？
articles.abstractCn: 当给大型语言模型（LLMs）提供模糊的提示时，生成的代码可能会违背开发者的隐含意图，然而标准的基准测试仅衡量代码是否通过其声明的测试。我们引入了意图违背率（IVR），并基于HumanEval+构建了一个包含49个问题的初步基准。每个问题都从澄清的提示中剥离隐含约束，并将其编码为隐藏的约束测试。IVR衡量的是LLM生成解决方案中，通过声明（可见）测试但未能通过捕捉未声明意图的隐藏约束测试的比例。评估Claude Sonnet 4.6和OpenAI GPT 4.1时，我们发现两者均通过超过92%的声明测试，但在超过一半的问题中违背意图（分别为54.5%和63.5%），且这种系统性的双峰模式在两个模型中均保持一致。我们的研究结果表明，通过率高估了生成代码反映开发者意图的程度。
